clue.text: Period of heat is a problem beside sea around Martinique

indicators.note: beside places one piece directly next to the other in a row

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem set in school
Martinique is French, and mer is the French word for sea

explanation.surface: A sailor complains about a heatwave on the waters off a Caribbean island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around Martinique' tells you which language to use for 'sea': the island is French, so the sea there is MER.
explanation.definitionFit: The warmest season of the year is naturally described as a period of heat.

clue.text: Enterprise, possibly joint, led by very famous people

indicators.note: led by means the other piece comes in front

parts.note: stars are celebrities, very famous people
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a business venture might be a shared one headed by celebrities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Enterprise' looks like a business; it is the spacecraft of Star Trek, hence 'possibly'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Enterprise of Star Trek is an example of a spacecraft, the 'possibly' marking the example.

clue.text: End up embracing a new craze

indicators.note: embracing means holding the other letters inside
in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: A fad finally comes to an end as something novel takes over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns AIM into MIA, and 'embracing' puts A and N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A craze is a wild enthusiasm, exactly what a mania is in everyday use.

clue.text: Take repast regularly?

indicators.note: regularly means take every other letter of the word before it, here the even ones

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether to have meals at fixed times.
explanation.definitionFit: To take food or a meal is to consume it, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Carpenter keen for what one may make with wood

definitions.text: what one may make with wood

parts.note: Chips is the traditional nickname for a carpenter, especially a ship's carpenter
hot means keen or eager, as in hot on something

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic woodworker considers what to make from timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wood' is not timber but a golf club; a short lofted stroke onto the green can be played with one.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf a wood is a club, and a short lofted stroke can be played with it.

clue.text: Bag made long ago displayed in large country house

indicators.note: displayed in means shown within the other word, so it goes inside

parts.note: a hall is a large country house, as in a stately manor
old means of long ago

explanation.surface: An antique bag is shown off in a stately home.
explanation.definitionFit: A capacious travelling bag for all sorts of things is a kind of bag.

clue.text: Base attack on the US

definitions.meaning: a US naval base in Hawaii
the Japanese raid of December 1941 that brought America into the war

explanation.walkthrough: Note the American spelling of the second word.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hawaiian naval base gave its name to the December 1941 raid on the United States.

clue.text: Golden girl's first success haphazard

indicators.note: first puts the following piece at the front of the answer

parts.note: a hit is a success, like a hit song
or is gold in heraldry
a miss is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: A golden girl's maiden triumph is a matter of luck.
explanation.walkthrough: In heraldry 'or' is the tincture gold, a convention worth knowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done at random with no plan is haphazard, an idiomatic equivalent.

clue.text: Expect to be gutted after instant lottery entry

indicators.note: after means the following piece comes later in the answer

parts.note: a tick is an instant, as in just a tick

indicators.note: gutting removes the insides, leaving only the first and last letters

explanation.surface: A gambler is crestfallen as instant scratchcard hopes come to nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Expect' is not a verb here but the word to be emptied of its middle letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip bought to take part in a draw is what one enters a lottery with.

clue.text: One taking out money that's in a chest

definitions.meaning: someone who draws money from a bank account
a sliding compartment in a chest of ...

explanation.definitionFit: One who draws money is a drawer, and a chest of drawers holds sliding compartments of that name.

clue.text: Plain gold's oddly neutral

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

indicators.note: oddly means the letters are arranged in an odd way

explanation.surface: A golden hue is said to be strangely neutral.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase for food served simply, without dressing, means plain.

clue.text: Native Mexican account about unknown pair of temples

indicators.note: about means going around the other letters

parts.note: z is an algebraic unknown

indicators.note: pair of takes the first two letters of the word

explanation.surface: A report on a couple of mysterious temples built by indigenous Mexicans.
explanation.walkthrough: In algebra the letters x, y and z stand for unknowns, so 'unknown' may give any of them.
explanation.definitionFit: The Aztecs were the indigenous people of central Mexico before the Spanish conquest.

clue.text: Put up with one chasing butterfly

parts.note: to swallow an insult is to put up with it
to tail someone is to follow them, so a tail is one chasing

explanation.surface: Tolerating someone pursuing a butterfly.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a species of butterfly with long tail-like extensions on its hind wings.

clue.text: One promoted queen ably matched in play?

indicators.note: in play suggests the letters are moved about playfully

explanation.surface: A promoted queen, well matched in a game of chess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'promoted queen' suggests a chess pawn; it is the Shakespeare character who became queen, and 'in play' doubles as a hint that she is from a play.
explanation.definitionFit: Macbeth's wife became queen when her husband took the Scottish throne.

clue.text: Port and whisky

definitions.meaning: a Cinque Port in East Sussex, England
a whisky made chiefly from this grain, popular in North America

explanation.definitionFit: Rye is an old harbour town in Sussex, and also a whisky distilled from that grain.

clue.text: I name Skywalker's enemy attacker

parts.note: Darth Vader is Luke Skywalker's foe in Star Wars

explanation.surface: Someone names Luke Skywalker's adversary as the aggressor.
explanation.definitionFit: One who invades is by nature an attacker.

clue.text: One description of helium flare

definitions.meaning: helium is far lighter than air, so it could be described this way
a coloured signal flare fired from a pistol

explanation.definitionFit: Helium is extremely low in weight, and the phrase also names a pistol-fired signal flare.

clue.text: Opening denial is demolished

indicators.note: demolished means knocked down and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A firm refusal is torn apart.
explanation.definitionFit: An introduction to a broadcast or piece of writing is an opening.

clue.text: Typical Englishman, taking good book on farm animal

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the other piece

parts.note: John is a book of the Gospels in the Bible, the Good Book
a bull is a male farm animal

explanation.surface: A stereotypical Englishman studies a fine book about livestock.
explanation.definitionFit: This cartoon figure has personified the typical Englishman since the eighteenth century.

clue.text: Admired person's suit above all others

definitions.meaning: a trump is an old word for a splendid, admired person
in card games the suit that beats every other suit

explanation.definitionFit: A fine fellow was once called a trump, and the winning suit in cards takes the same name.

clue.text: Space vehicle close to lunar equator, at first

parts.note: to close is to shut

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of each of the words before it

explanation.surface: A spacecraft passes near the moon's equator early in its mission.
explanation.definitionFit: A reusable craft that ferries crew into orbit was the American space vehicle of that name.

clue.text: Mexican state's tortilla dish includes sea fish, for the most part

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so this reads Mexican state is

indicators.note: includes means the other piece goes inside

parts.note: a taco is a folded filled tortilla

indicators.note: for the most part drops the final letter of the fish's name

parts.note: bass is a sea fish, as in sea bass

explanation.surface: A Mexican region's tortilla speciality is filled with seafood.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's in 'state's' stands for 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabasco is one of the states of Mexico, on the Gulf coast.

clue.text: Drumming that's piercing?

definitions.meaning: a rapid rhythmic beating, as on a drum
skin decorated by needles piercing it with ink

explanation.definitionFit: A drumbeat summoning soldiers is one sense, and a needle-inked design on the skin is the other.

clue.text: Son took poor abode, wanting something for digs

parts.note: a hovel is a wretched, poor dwelling

explanation.surface: A son moves into a squalid home, lacking a place to stay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'digs' looks like lodgings, matching the house story; here it is the verb, digging.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool used for digging is something for digs, the noun read as a verb.

clue.text: Note sent back for prince

indicators.note: sent back means the word is read in reverse

parts.note: lah is the sixth note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A message is returned to a royal.
explanation.definitionFit: Prince Hal is the young future Henry V in Shakespeare's history plays.

clue.text: Authorise information board next to the till?

definitions.meaning: to add a confirming signature to a document

definitions.text: information board next to the till?
definitions.meaning: a notice on a shop counter, where the till sits

explanation.definitionFit: Adding a second signature authorises a document, and a sign on a shop counter fits the other reading.

clue.text: Slow to turn upside down, lacking velocity

indicators.note: lacking means the following letter is removed

parts.note: to invert is to turn upside down
v is the physics symbol for velocity

explanation.surface: Something sluggish to flip over has lost speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inactive and sluggish, reluctant to move, is slow.

clue.text: See fit to be imprecise

parts.note: v is short for vide, Latin for see, used in references
an ague is a fit of shivering fever

explanation.surface: Someone thinks it acceptable to be inexact.
explanation.definitionFit: Being vague means being unclear or not precise.

clue.text: Clothes collected for a purpose — tons needed by painter

indicators.note: needed by means the first piece is wanted at the front of the second

parts.note: Henri Rousseau was a French naive painter

explanation.surface: An artist needs a huge pile of clothes for a particular project.
explanation.definitionFit: A bride's collection of clothes gathered for her marriage is a set assembled with a purpose.

clue.text: Almost fight well

indicators.note: almost means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: to spar is to fight, as boxers do

explanation.surface: Two people nearly come to blows, then make up.
explanation.definitionFit: A spa is a mineral spring, which is a kind of well.

clue.text: Sort of self-reliant child they lack, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Children who must fend for themselves are missing something, regrettably.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase describes a child who lets themselves in after school, so is self-reliant.
explanation.definitionFit: A child with a door key who lets themselves in after school is a self-reliant type.

clue.text: Let drivers back into ring

indicators.note: back means the whole run is read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written
the RAC is the Royal Automobile Club, a British motorists' organisation

explanation.surface: Motorists are allowed to return to a circuit.
explanation.walkthrough: The RAC is a British motoring organisation; 'back' reverses LET + RAC together.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring in commerce is a group of firms fixing prices, which is a cartel.
